changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.8.4:

• 🔊 Live Screen Share Voice Mute Fix: Fixed issue where JARVIS went silent or muted when screen sharing was active. Screen sharing is now unconditionally exempt from background standby, allowing crystal-clear bidirectional voice conversation while browsing any app.

• 🗣️ Spoken Confirmation on Screen Share Start & Stop: JARVIS now immediately announces out loud: 'Screen share on ho gaya hai Sir, main aapki screen dekh rahi hoon' when screen share starts, and confirms when it stops.

• 🔄 Continuous Hands-Free Conversation: Seamless conversation during screen sharing without needing to say 'Hey Jarvis' before every question.
